text: Waiting the 5 minutes is only for a seizure on a normal dose. Psychedelics can lower the seizure threshold even at a normal dose, so someone with epilepsy or who's otherwise prone to seizures can have a seizure without taking too much. Their seizure is most likely less dangerous than an actual drug overdose seizure.
reader: someone whose friend is having a seizure right now, deciding what to do while it lasts, when to call medics, and whether to give a rescue medicine they have

marked.s: - Don't restrain them, since that can cause injuries, but do put pillows where appropriate, especially under the head.
Their seizure is most likely less dangerous than an actual drug overdose seizure.
These medicines are benzodiazepines in nasal spray or rectal gel, or sometimes an intramuscular shot (pills can't be swallowed).

After giving it, keep a close eye on their breathing, since a benzodiazepine adds to the risk of it getting slow and shallow, especially if they've also taken other respiratory depressants like opioids or alcohol.
